en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing an outdoor swimming pool complex with many bathers, surrounded by tall poplar trees and a grandstand with tiered seating and changing facilities below. The front caption reads "Pécs" on the left and "Strandfürdő" on the right. The reverse side has a green Hungarian postage stamp, handwritten Hungarian text, and a Budapest address.
